Subject: RE: Tuesday Netball (Eclipse) - Fank you :)

Hi Tony,

I thought the response from the centre was a bit weird... 
Especially the fact whoever responded didn't put their name to it. It
made me think they didn't want us to know who it was or something... 
Or maybe I'm reading too much into it!
Mostly I thought the response was a bit of a cop out... if I were
running that place I'd be taking on board the suggestions with a view to
improving draws and grading for all teams... not just making the problem
go away for one team by moving them to a different grade. But hey, I
can't be bothered to argue about it, and we get to try C grade so I
figure we should just be happy with that!
Hope the bee stung foot is ok... See you tomorrow night :)

Cheers,
Jacs

> -----Original Message-----
> From: Tony Meyer [mailto:user2.1@gvc.ceas-challenge.cc]
> Sent: Friday, 14 March 2008 8:52 p.m.
> To: Hawkins, Jacinta
> Subject: Re: Tuesday Netball (Eclipse) - Fank you :)
> 
> > Just a quick thank you for taking the time to put into an email all
> > the
> > netball issues we've discussed. I think you summed them up nicely!
> 
> No worries & thanks.  I was a bit concerned that it was too long
> winded (my writing tends to be ;)) but whenever I made it shorter it
> seemed to get more like a complaining rant and less like real
> concerns.  I guess it worked, anyway.
> 
> > Here's to C grade after Easter... Maybe now we'll start playing some
B
> > grade teams ;)
> 
> :)  The bottom of B grade would be a nice change, anyway!
> 
> In terms of what they said (I don't care enough to reply to them):
> 
> > First lets answer how the draw works; We endeavor to play a double
> > round robin with playoffs and Finals. As you can imagine this
> > becomes increasingly difficult as teams pullout, can only play when
> > the moon is at a certain point in the sky etc. This means that
> > sometimes you don't get to play a team in your grade.
> 
> Teams pulling out is obviously a problem.  Maybe that was what
> happened last season - but that would mean that about half the teams
> pulled out, and that seems pretty odd.  It also would have to
> coincidentally be the exact teams that we hadn't yet played.  As for
> teams only playing at particular times and that sort of thing - I
> understand that some times are better than others, but AFAIK we will
> play at any of the times, which means we could play anyone needing a
> specific time.  I think teams should just be told that it's not
> possible, anyway - it's just not how things work.
> 
> > Now to Grading, if you won a grade you will automatically be
> > promoted and in theory if you are the last in a grade you will be
> > demoted (usually) however this dosent always work in the higher
> > grades as poor A grade team can sometimes be far to strong etc. We
> > would expect a promoted team, that retains all its players, would
> > win 25-30% of its games in the new grade. If as you state you lost
> > 1/2 the team I can understand the difficulty you have been having.
> 
> Interesting that there's the automatic promotion.  I presume winning
> means coming first in the finals and it doesn't count if you kick
> everyone in points but lose the final.  I guess that means that
> Hobbits must have lost the final, since they're still B grade.
> 
> Interesting also that they didn't know that we only had half the
> original team (which was a different night of course).  I would have
> thought that given the whole Ed situation and that Erica talked to
> them when we had Fliss that would have been known.  Not sure who
> answered the email, of course, since it wasn't signed.
> 
> Anyway, moving to C will let us know where we belong, anyway.
> 
> Cheers,
> Tony
